title: Build skill: find recent relevant X posts + generate meaningful replies
description:
Develop a reusable agent skill that: (1) finds recent, relevant X/Twitter posts for a given topic/query, and (2) generates context-aware, meaningful reply drafts for each post.

Requirements:
- Input: topic/query, optional filters (language, min engagement, freshness window)
- Discovery: return a ranked list of recent relevant posts with URL, author, timestamp, and why relevant
- Reply generation: produce thoughtful, non-generic replies tailored to each post’s content and thread context
- Anti-spam constraints: avoid repetitive templates; include novelty checks
- Safety: avoid toxic/harassing content and unverified factual claims
- Output format: structured JSON + readable markdown summary
- Include a short evaluation section: relevance quality, reply quality rubric, and failure cases

Deliverables:
1) Skill spec (SKILL.md style)
2) Implementation plan / pseudo-code or scripts
3) 5 example runs on different topics with generated replies
4) Notes on limits, edge cases, and improvements
